introParagraphs: Hi! I'm Tanmay Mohite, an Electronics & Telecommunication engineering student with a strong passion for software development, AI, and modern technology. I enjoy building practical and visually engaging digital experiences that combine functionality with clean design.

My journey started with experimenting in Python and electronics-based projects, which gradually evolved into creating AI-powered assistants, automation tools, and responsive web interfaces. I love exploring how hardware and software can work together to solve real-world problems efficiently.

I focus on writing organized, scalable, and user-friendly code while constantly learning new technologies and development practices. My interests include artificial intelligence, frontend development, embedded systems, and interactive applications.
Beyond coding, I actively participate in technical projects, research new innovations in technology, and enjoy collaborating on creative ideas that push my skills further.
